headline: Zero-Install 8-Ball Pool with Real Spin Physics
text:
Need a quick 8-ball pool break without ads or downloads?

Real cue spin physics, cushion restitution, called pockets, and 3 AI tiers—running instantly in pure vanilla JS.

Play right now:
https://kreeda.games/break-room/index.html
